summary: All 17 quoted spans (Isaiah 52:13-53:12 excerpts, Isaiah 49:3, Acts 8:32/34/35) are KJV verbatim word-for-word; narrative facts (Ethiopian eunuch reading in his chariot, Philip sent by the Spirit, rich-in-death grave, poured-out soul) match the source; doctrine is sound penal substitution that steel-mans then answers the Israel reading from the text, hints resurrection conservatively, lands on Jesus, and closes grace-anchored.
